pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft-edged gradients. Spatial area varies from small, densely clustered patches on the posterior flank to larger, vertically elongated blocks on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Off-white negative space forming a continuous web-like structure. Pixel thickness is greater in the neck region compared to the narrower pathways on the flank. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-directional intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck composed of dark brown follicles against a blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism perched on the dorsal-cervical junction, causing localized occlusion of the mane and dorsal ridge profile.
